question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the word: **ESCHEW**
solution:
The correct answer is: **3) Avoid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Eschew"** means to deliberately avoid or abstain from something, especially on moral or practical grounds. (बचना)
 
 
• **Example:** He eschewed all forms of luxury to live a simple and meaningful life.
 
 
• The correct word **"Avoid"** refers to keeping away from or stopping oneself from doing something. (टालना)
 
 
• **Example:** She avoided the crowded streets by taking a longer but quieter route.
 
 
• Thus, "Avoid" is the most appropriate synonym for "Eschew."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **3) Avoid**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accept** (स्वीकार करना): To consent to receive or undertake something willingly.
 
 
• **Example:** He graciously accepted the award for his contributions to the community.
 
 
 
• **Embrace** (गले लगाना): To willingly or enthusiastically accept or adopt something.
 
 
• **Example:** She embraced the opportunity to learn a new skill.
 
 
 
• **Pursue** (पीछा करना): To follow or chase something in order to achieve or catch it.
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to pursue his dream of becoming a musician.
